chapter.verse: Tu-in Caesarea khua ah Italy ci-a kithei galkap thuangpi khat om a, tua takah Cornelius minnei, galkap za-uk bu khat om hi.
Amah pen a innkuan bupun Pasian a kihta, biakna hahkat mi khat hi a, mite' tungah citpiak huhna tampi a piakhia, Pasian' kianga thungen tawntung khat, ahi hi.
Khatvei, sunnung nai thum pawlin muhtuam khat nei a, Pasian' vanmi khat hong pai-in, “Cornelius aw,” ci-in amah a sap, teltakin mu hi.
Tua ciangin launa tawh tua vanmi a et kawmin, “Bang thu om hiam, Topa?” ci hi. Vanmi in, “Na thungetnate leh huhna na piakkhiatte Pasian' mai-ah phawk-huai thu khatin kahto khinzo hi.
Tu-in Joppa ah mite sawl inla, Peter a kici Simon a khat pen sam in.
Amah pen tuipi gei-a teeng savunnim Simon' inn ah zintung hi,” ci hi.
Amah a hopih vanmi a paikhiat khit ciangin Cornelius in ama' innsung nasemte nih leh ama' kianga nasemhuhte lakpan biakna hahkat galkap khat sam a,
amaute' kiangah a thu teng a gen khit ciangin Joppa khua ah paisak hi.
A zingciangin tua mite khualzinin Joppa khua a naih laitak, sunkim nai sawmlenih pawlin thungen dingin innkhum tungah Peter kahto hi.
Tua ciangin amah a gilkialin an duh hi. An a kibawl laitak Peter mumang bangin om a,
vantung kihongin dial golpi tawh a kibang vanzat khat, a kiu lite pan leitung ah hong kikhaisuk mu hi.
Tua sungah ganhing a namkim, leilak-a gamta khelinei nam, bokvak awmtal nam leh huihlak-a leng vasa nam cih bangin om hi.
Tua ciangin awging khat in Peter hopih a, “Peter aw, tho inla go-in ne in,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in, “Topa aw, ka ne peuhmah kei ding hi. A hang pen a thanghuai leh a sianglo peuhmah ka ne ngeikei hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin awging in a nihveina hopih a, “Pasian' siansaksa khat thanghuai ci kei in,” ci hi.
Hih danin thumvei a pian khit ciangin tua vanzat pen vantung ah thakhatin kilato hi.

Tu-in Peter pen a ngahkhak muhtuam thu bang hiding ci-in sunglam lungbuai-in a om laitak, en un, Simon' inn omna mun kanin a theician khin Cornelius' sawl mite zong inn kongpi mai hong tung lian uh a,
Peter a kici Simon hih mun ah zintung hiam, ci-in awngin sam uh hi.
Peter ahihleh a muhtuam thu a lungngaingai hi a, tua laitak Kha in, “En in, mi thum in nang hong zong uh hi.
Kithawi inla, kumsuk in. Tua mite keima' sawl ahih manin lunghiang lo-in va kithuah in,” ci hi.
Peter zong tua mite' kiangah paisuk a, “Na zon pen uh ka hi hi. Nong paina uh bang vai ahi hiam?” ci hi.

Amaute in, “Cornelius a kici, a thutang, Pasian a kihta, Jew gam bup in zong a phat uh, galkap za-uk bu khat om a, ama' inn ah nang hong sam dingin leh nang' tungpan thugenna a ngai dingin vanmi siangtho khat in amah hilhphawnna pia hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in zintung dingin amaute kho hi. A zingciangin Peter kithawi-in amaute tawh dingkhia a, Joppa pan sanggam thu-um kimkhat in zong va zui uh hi.
A zingciangin Caesarea tung uh a, Cornelius in amaute na ngakin a tanaute leh a lawm itdeuhte na khokhol hi.
Inn sungah Peter a tum ciangin Cornelius in amah na dawn a, a khe-phung ah boksukin bia hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in amah phongto a, “Ding in. Kei zong mihing mah ka hi lel hi,” ci hi.
Cornelius tawh kiho kawmin Peter a lut ciangin Peter in mi tampitak kikaikhawmin om mu hi.

Tua ciangin amaute' kiangah, “Jew mi khat' adingin namdang mite tawh kikholh ding leh amau' kiangah hawh ding pen phaltheihloh cih nomaumah na theih uh ahi hi. Himah taleh mi khatpeuh a thanghuai ahihkeileh a sianglo cihloh ding Pasian in hong lak khinzo hi.
Tua hangin kei hong kisap ciangin nial vet lo-in kong pai hi. Tu-in nong sapna thu nong gen thei ding hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Cornelius in, “Tuma ni li lai, tu bang hunlenai pawl, nai kuana hunin ka inn ah thu ka nget laitak, en in, puan a te deldel a silh pasal khat ka mai-ah hong ding a,
‘Cornelius aw, na thungetna leh huhna na piakkhiatte Pasian' mai-ah kiciamteh khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin Joppa ah mi sawl inla Peter a kici Simon samsak in. Amah pen tuipi gei-a savunnim Simon' inn ah zintung hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua hangin nang kong samsak pah a, nang zong thukhualna tawh nong pai hi. Tua hi a, tu-in Topa in nang hong vaikhak teng khempeuh a ngai dingin ko teng ka vekun Pasian' mai-ah kong om uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter kamka-in hih bangin thugen hi: “Pasian pen guptuam paihtuam a neilo ahihlam tu-in ka tel takpi hi.
Minam citeng sungpan amah zahtakin a diktat peuhmah Pasian' mai-ah a santaak ahi hi.
Note in Israel mite' tunga hong sawlkhiat thu, (vekpi' Topa ahi) Jesu Khris' hanga kingah, nopna lemna tawh kipawl Lungdamna Thu a kitangko pen na thei uh hi.
Tua banah John in baptizena thu a tangko khit, Galilee gam pana kipan Judea gam sung mun citenga a piang thu,

Pasian in Kha Siangtho leh vangliatna tawh Nazareth khuami Jesu sathau a nilhna thu, tua Jesu pai kawikawi-in nahoih a sepna thu, Pasian in ompih ahih manin dawimangpa' bawlsiat mi khempeuh a damsakna thu, cihte zong na thei uh hi.
Tua hi a, kote pen Jew gam sung leh Jerusalem khua-a Jesu' sep teng khempeuh a mu a thei tecite ka hi uh hi. Amaute in singkhuam tungah amah khai-in thatlum uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in ni thumna ciangin thokiksak a, a kilang dingin phal hi.
Tua pen mi citeng tungah hilo-in misite' lakpan a thawhkik khit amah tawh a nekhawm a dawnkhawm, teci dinga Pasian' teelsa ko teng bek' tungah ahi hi.
Amah in mite' kiangah thutangko dingin leh amah pen a nungta mite leh misite' tungah thukhen mang dingin Pasian' sehpa hi cih thu, teci khauhtak a pang dingin kote thupiak hong nei hi.
Kamsang khempeuh in zong amah a um mi peuhmah ama' min hangin mawhmaina ngah ding ci-in ama' thu teci pang uh hi.”
Hih thute Peter in a gen laitak thungaite khempeuh' tungah Kha Siangtho tung hi.
Gentile mite' tung nangawn ah deihguat thupha Kha Siangtho kibuak ahih manin Peter tawh a tonkhawm vun-at mite' lakpan thu-um mite in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
A hang pen tua Gentile mite, kamtuam tawh pau-in Pasian a phat uh amaute in za uh hi. Tua ciangin Peter in thugen zom a,
“Ei' ngah banga Kha Siangtho a ngah hih mite baptize loh nadingin kua in tui kham thei ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu Khris' min tawh a kibaptize nadingun amaute vaikhak hi. Amaute in zong tawlkhat sung a taam lai nadingin Peter kho uh hi.
